title: The last whistle, from the school
logline: The last whistle heard from the high school's cafeteria: a room of students from behind, heads turned to the window, the jagged shape coming in over the tables. Which back is fourteen and will draw this: not said.

panels.composition: A school cafeteria in 1994 from the back: rows of students from behind with heads turned toward the tall windows, a long jagged whistle shape coming in through the glass over the tables, Era I spotting in the ceiling's dark.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a school cafeteria seen from the back with rows of students from behind turning their heads toward tall windows where a long jagged sound shape comes in over the tables, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Heard from the cafeteria. Which back: not said.
